metadata.scope: Provenance-aware TCP parameter library for BioRT. Initial records cover prostate EBRT/SBRT and recurrent previously irradiated head-and-neck SBRT.
metadata.clinical_use_warning: Decision support and model validation only. A model must not be used outside its exact endpoint, target/dose descriptor, disease context, time point and fractionation domain.
metadata.selection_principle: Each parameter set is an indivisible source-specific record. D50, gamma, alpha/beta and other parameters from different studies or model families must not be mixed.
metadata.target_rule: An anatomical PTV name alone is insufficient to select a TCP model. Diagnosis, treatment setting, endpoint and target/dose definition must be explicit.

linear_poisson_eqd2_dvh.summary: Per-bin EQD2 followed by the TG-166 linear-Poisson local-control product over differential target DVH bins.

poisson_power2_eqd2_prescription.source_framework: Royce et al. prostate SBRT TCP model

logistic_equivalent_fraction_count_dose.summary: Scalar logistic dose-response after LQ conversion of prescription dose to the source model's reference fraction count.
logistic_equivalent_fraction_count_dose.source_framework: Vargo et al. recurrent head-and-neck SBRT pooled dose-response

target.description: CT-defined prostate gland used as the response-defining target; mpMRI-GTV was analyzed separately but fit less well.

endpoint.name: biochemical relapse-free survival
endpoint.definition: Phoenix definition after definitive EBRT with or without androgen deprivation therapy
endpoint.time_point: mixed follow-up; median 81.4 months, range 42-149 months

dose_basis.metric: individual prostate-gland DVH converted per bin to EQD2 before linear-quadratic Poisson TCP aggregation

source.citation: Sachpazidis I, Mavroidis P, Zamboglou C, Klein CM, Grosu AL, Baltas D. Prostate cancer tumour control probability modelling for external beam radiotherapy based on multi-parametric MRI-GTV definition. Radiat Oncol. 2020;15:242.

prostate_models.implementation_notes: Source-specific DVH model for localized intermediate/high-risk prostate cancer. Do not substitute a generic PTV DVH for the CT-defined prostate-gland target. The source cohort contained both intermediate- and high-risk patients, but the TCP fit was not stratified into separate risk-group parameter sets.

dose_basis.metric: individual prostate-gland DVH converted per bin to EQD2

source.citation: Sachpazidis I et al. Prostate cancer tumour control probability modelling for external beam radiotherapy based on multi-parametric MRI-GTV definition. Radiat Oncol. 2020;15:242.

prostate_models.implementation_notes: Five-year refit from the same cohort. The fitted alpha/beta confidence interval was undefined, so absolute-risk interpretation requires caution. The source cohort contained both intermediate- and high-risk patients, but the TCP fit was not stratified into separate risk-group parameter sets.

target.description: Pooled prostate SBRT prescription dose; patient-level DVHs were unavailable.

endpoint.name: freedom from biochemical relapse
endpoint.definition: pooled 5-year FFBR for low/intermediate-risk localized prostate cancer

dose_basis.metric: prescription dose converted to EQD2 using alpha/beta=1.5 Gy
dose_basis.source_data_limit: reviewed cohorts did not include prescription EQD2 below approximately 80 Gy; lower-dose curve is extrapolative

source.citation: Royce TJ et al. Tumor Control Probability Modeling and Systematic Review of the Literature of Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy for Prostate Cancer. IJROBP. 2021;110:227-236.

prostate_models.implementation_notes: The source reports D50=20.6 Gy and gamma=0.15, but those values inserted into the paper's displayed Poisson equation do not reproduce the same paper's stated 5-year predictions of 90% at EQD2=71 Gy and 95% at EQD2=90 Gy. BioRT preserves the published values but disables runtime calculation until the discrepancy is resolved from supplementary/source data or author clarification.

implementation.runtime_note: Do not repair or substitute gamma by inference. The source discrepancy must remain explicit.
implementation.runtime_reason: Runtime disabled: published low/intermediate-risk D50/gamma values are numerically inconsistent with the paper's own stated 90%/95% TCP dose points under the displayed equation.

implementation.runtime_note: The published D50=84.2 Gy and gamma=4.50 reproduce the paper's stated approximately 90% TCP at EQD2=97 Gy and 95% at EQD2=102 Gy. Source sample remains limited (85 patients from 3 studies).

head_neck_models.implementation_notes: The 3-year dose-response was statistically significant in the pooled analysis, but the number at risk was smaller than at earlier time points.

evidence_only.key_findings: Pooled 46-study analysis compared six biophysical models. Fits consistently favored large alpha/beta around 20 Gy; BED calculated with alpha/beta=20 Gy around 90 Gy was associated with TCP >=95% for T1 tumors. The regrowth model fit better than the other five.
evidence_only.reason_not_computable_here: The full source contains multiple model families and stage-specific parameter sets. BioRT will not select one parameter row until the exact model table is extracted and independently regression-tested.
